documents.title: Resetting Your Password
documents.text: To reset your password, go to Settings > Security > Reset Password, then follow the link emailed to the account's registered address to choose a new password.

documents.title: Account Security & Two-Factor Authentication
documents.text: Two-factor authentication can be enabled from Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. We recommend an authenticator app over SMS codes.

documents.title: Updating Your Billing Email
documents.text: Customers can update their own billing email from Account > Billing > Billing Contact without needing analyst assistance.

documents.title: Getting Started Guide
documents.text: New accounts are guided through a short setup wizard on first login: workspace name, invite teammates, and connect a data source.
